name: Vocabulary
summary: Use context and word parts to choose the precise meaning of a word.

name: Grammar and Usage
summary: Match subjects and verbs, keep tenses consistent, and place modifiers correctly.

name: Sentence Completion
summary: Read the signal words — contrast, cause, addition — to predict what fits the blank.

name: Reading Comprehension
summary: Separate the main idea from supporting detail and answer only what the passage supports.

name: Analogy
summary: Name the relationship in the given pair first, then look for the same relationship.

name: Basic Operations
summary: Apply PEMDAS carefully and keep signs straight when adding and subtracting.

name: Fractions and Decimals
summary: Convert between fractions, decimals and percents, then simplify to lowest terms.

name: Percentages
summary: Break percentages into friendly parts (10%, 5%, 1%) to compute them mentally.

name: Ratio and Proportion
summary: Set up the proportion so matching units sit opposite each other, then solve.

name: Word Problems
summary: Translate the sentence into an equation before calculating anything.

name: Number Series
summary: Check differences first, then ratios, then alternating or combined patterns.

name: Logical Deduction
summary: Accept only what the premises force; reject anything that merely sounds likely.

name: Data Interpretation
summary: Read the question before the data so you know which figure actually matters.

name: Assumptions and Conclusions
summary: An assumption is an unstated premise the argument needs; a conclusion follows from it.

name: Alphabetizing and Filing
summary: Compare letter by letter from the left, and file surnames before given names.

name: Spelling and Word Usage
summary: Watch for doubled letters and commonly confused pairs such as affect and effect.

name: Clerical Checking
summary: Compare digit by digit and group long numbers so nothing shifts unnoticed.

name: Record Keeping
summary: Keep totals and balances consistent; a difference of one entry should be traceable.

name: Philippine Constitution
summary: Know the structure of government, the Bill of Rights and the independent commissions.

name: Code of Conduct and Ethics
summary: Remember the eight norms of conduct and the duties expected of every public servant.

name: Peace and Human Rights
summary: Know the basic rights guaranteed by the Constitution and how they may be limited.

name: Environment Management
summary: Apply the reduce-reuse-recycle hierarchy and know the agencies responsible for it.
